spindle.environment.CapabilityKey.title: CapabilityKey
spindle.environment.CapabilityKey.description: A capability name, which provides exactly that capability, or a prefix ending in `.*`, which provides every capability under that prefix (README.md:101-102, crates/spindle-capability/src/environment.rs:22-23,35).

spindle.environment.Provision.title: Provision
spindle.environment.Provision.description: One key of the environment document's `provides` and its implementations, in order of preference (README.md:101, crates/spindle-capability/src/environment.rs:35-37).

capability.description: The capability, or the `prefix.*` key, these implementations provide (crates/spindle-capability/src/environment.rs:35).

implementations.description: The implementations that provide it, each named by its identifier, most preferred first (README.md:101, crates/spindle-capability/src/environment.rs:35).
